completeness_contract.complete: all seven fields structurally present, AVAILABLE, timestamp-eligible, non-stale, raw-preserved, and normalized
completeness_contract.complete_with_governed_missing: structurally present explicit unavailable status only when a future accepted source-calendar rule proves normal source closure; never for API failure, timestamp ambiguity, or stale data
completeness_contract.incomplete: any unresolved timestamp, missing raw evidence, source failure, stale field, unresolved stale rule, or failed normalization
completeness_contract.smoke_test_admission: only COMPLETE or explicitly governed COMPLETE_WITH_GOVERNED_MISSING

flat_thresholds.authority: market_scoring.js flat threshold is an Outcome-reaction pip rule, not an accepted cross-asset market-state threshold; it cannot be reused.
flat_thresholds.rule: Retain numeric 24-hour and five-observation changes only; omit ungoverned categorical direction fields from PACK_E_PROSPECTIVE_V1 V1 output.

lead_time.reason: Source-specific hard timeouts are not accepted and strict source availability cannot be calculated from date-only rows.

raw_preservation.implementation_note: Current v2B fetch normalizers do not provide this artifact; a future return-only adapter must implement it under separate authority.
raw_preservation.write_order: persist append-only local raw evidence before normalized Pack materialization

stale_authority.reason: No accepted local source calendar identifies expected publication cadence, holidays, or a maximum acceptable age for any of the seven daily/date-only routes.

timeout_authority.current_transport: UrlFetchApp.fetch with HTTP failure handling but no adapter-level hard timeout parameter in the FRED, EODHD, or FMP market-context helpers
timeout_authority.reason: No accepted source-specific connection/request or total-operation timeout exists, so a bounded maximum prerequisite execution window cannot be derived.
timeout_authority.safe_resume_requirement: A future adapter must record request intent before transport, terminal response evidence on completion, and REMOTE_STATE_UNRESOLVED on interruption; no duplicate read may be assumed safe without its frozen request identity.
